confidence_notes: Meal and coffee estimates draw on [Numbeo’s June 2026 snapshot](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Siem-Reap); draft beer is informed by its more recent data. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and reflect a premium over local draft beer, informed by limited [local restaurant and bar prices](https://thediscreetgentleman.com/countries/cambodia/siem-reap/wat-bo/embassy-restaurant-and-bar). Accommodation figures are holistic July rainy-season estimates and may vary considerably.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Cambodia and other mainland Southeast Asian tourist cities, adjusted for Siem Reap’s temple tourism and July rainy-season demand.
